verdict.rationale: AMD's MI355X product page publishes 288GB of HBM3E memory and 8TB/s bandwidth, and Chips and Cheese independently repeats those figures. That covers capacity, memory type, and bandwidth, but nothing in the pack gives the memory bus width, so the spec set is not shown as complete. Missing for 10: published memory bus width, and evidence of a full first-party spec sheet listing all memory parameters together.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth

citations.quote: MI355X offers 288 GB of HBM3E at 8 TB/s
